data.description:
## Observation
During ba95-a378-62a5-422c verification, full make verify with PYTEST_WORKERS=2 failed once at tests/unit/test_mcp_entrypoint_provisioning.py::test_a_peer_finishing_the_clone_while_we_wait_skips_the_redundant_reclone. The same test passed immediately when run alone: pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_entrypoint_provisioning.py::test_a_peer_finishing_the_clone_while_we_wait_skips_the_redundant_reclone -q => 1 passed in 211.54s. A prior closed ticket (7680-85c7-af0d-416f) records the same transient shape.

## Problem
This appears to be an existing xdist/order/concurrency flake in the MCP entrypoint provisioning test, not caused by the pytest resource guard change. It can consume full-suite verification time and mask the true status of unrelated changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Reproduce the failure under xdist without unrelated code changes, or prove the historical occurrences are no longer actionable.
- [ ] Fix the test or fixture so it is deterministic under the default parallel scheduler without weakening the assertion.
- [ ] Add/retain regression evidence that the peer-finished clone path still skips redundant reclone.
data.title: mcp entrypoint provisioning test flakes under xdist
